acknowledges: A candidate with a Python file is not a finished technology asset.
A candidate that 'passes' against its own comparator is not finished.
A candidate whose model has never been independently reproduced is not finished.
A candidate with no economic proof is not finished.
A candidate with no prior-art dossier is not finished.
A candidate with no technology-transfer package is not finished.
commitments: Will not claim TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY without all 20 criteria (C01-C20) audited.
Will not count a failed candidate as finished.
Will not count a candidate as 'verified' because it ran twice.
Will not count a candidate as finished because it has a price tag.
Will not endlessly iterate on a failed candidate — repair budget = 1.
Will not inflate the active count by inventing new candidates.
Will use the standard simulator registry (Article XXXVI §6) for independent verification.
Will label every economic claim with evidence tier (MODELLED / PUBLICLY_VERIFIED / BUYER_VERIFIED).
Will surface threats in the differentiation dossier, not just favorable art.
Will preserve the full HYPOTHESIS→READY provenance chain (Article XXXVI §10).
forbidden_anti_patterns_acknowledged: Choosing the attractive result (P-16: 744 μW diffusion approximation vs. ~300 μW MCX-verified)
Widening tolerance after the comparison run
Treating MCX or any external solver as infallible
Filing a candidate as TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY without resolving MODEL_DISAGREEMENT
Treating a second run of own code as independent verification
Inventing prior art to look thorough (R274 negative-search provenance rule still in force)
Counting FAIL candidates as 'in progress' indefinitely
Endlessly iterating on failed candidates (budget = 1, second failure is terminal)
ceos_test_internalized: Could you take any one of the 15 folders tomorrow, hand it to a competent engineering team, and have them start evaluating the technology without needing us to explain away gaps? Until YES for all 15, the work is not finished.
constitutional_basis: Article XXXVI (R309 amendment to Epistemic Constitution v1.5.0)
